decisions.reason: Premium support draws directly on the firm's core competence of round-the-clock expert service, so it can interpret customer feedback and refine the offer easily.
The version manager extends the firm's own tool suite (security center, recovery manager), where its in-house development gives it the knowledge to keep improving the tool.

A legal data-processing contract generator lies outside the firm's hosting know-how, which limits its ability to learn from results and maintain the tool as regulations change, so resources are better redirected to core hosting.
Scalable agency hosting sits at the heart of the firm's platform, data center capacity and agency-focused strategy, making it easy to absorb feedback and develop further.
